issues.title: Add request routing and set up the CI pipeline
issues.spec: This ticket covers two pieces of work. First, add URL routing to the web server: parse the request path, dispatch to the matching handler, and return 404 for unknown routes. Second, and entirely separately, set up the continuous-integration pipeline: a GitHub Actions workflow that installs dependencies, runs the test suite, and runs the linter on every pull request. The routing work touches src/server/*; the CI work touches .github/workflows/* — they share no code and could ship in either order.

question: Does ISS-S's spec cover two structurally-independent, each-ticket-sized concerns (splittable)? If so, list the independent concerns; if it is one cohesive concern, return an empty list.
